scope

(noun). khả năng giành được cái gì đó

There's still plenty of scope for improvement.

envision

(verb). hình dung

They envision an equal society, free of poverty and disease.

playwright

(noun). nhà viết kịch

Which playwright wrote ‘Doctor Faustus’?

coin

(verb). làm tiền xu, sáng chế

The term ‘cardboard city’ was coined to describe communities of homeless people living in cardboard boxes.

visual

(adjective). mang tính trực quan

The building makes a tremendous visual impact.

internal

(adjective). Ở trong, bên trong, nội bộ, nội địa

This is the internal structure of a building.

replicate

(verb). sao chép, bắt chước

Subsequent experiments failed to replicate these findings.

transistor

(noun). dụng cụ điện tử nhỏ

Transistors have to be used in all the satellites because valves are too heavy.

circuit

(noun). vòng, chu vi

The race ended with eight laps of a city centre circuit.

microprocessor

(noun). Bộ vi xử lý

The first microprocessor built in 1971 had 2300 transistors.

prototype

(noun). bản mẫu

Scientists have developed a working prototype for the machine.

observer

(noun). người quan sát

According to observers, the plane exploded shortly after take-off.

through

(preposition). qua, xuyên qua, suốt

The burglar got in through the window.

imbed

(verb). nhúng, gắn vào

The bullet imbedded itself in the wall.

configuration

(noun). cấu hình

The design is based on four configurations of squares.

database

(noun). cơ sở dữ liệu

The database is updated monthly.

standard

(noun). tiêu chuẩn

There has been a fall in living standards.

facial

(adjective). liên quan tới mặt

Casey suffered a facial cut in the accident.

expression

(noun). biểu cảm

Only in his dreams does he give expression to his fears.

emotion

(noun). cảm giác

They expressed mixed emotions at the news.

ensemble

(noun). tập hợp

The Mozart Ensemble is/are playing at Carnegie Hall tonight.

pressure

(noun). ép, áp lực ai đó

The pressure for change continued to mount.

adjust

(verb). điều chỉnh

Watch out for sharp bends and adjust your speed accordingly.

rhythm

(noun). nhịp điều

I listened to the steady rhythm of her breathing.

terminal

(noun). bến

The new high-speed train will stop at a terminal to be built at Kings Cross station.

transaction

(noun). giao dịch

Electronic banking may make over-the-counter transactions obsolete.

withstand

(verb). chịu được

The materials used have to be able to withstand high temperatures.

accelerate

(verb). gia tốc

Exposure to the sun can accelerate the ageing process.

exploitable

(adjective). Có thể khai thác, có thể khai khẩn

The coal mine is no longer commercially exploitable.

pace

(noun). nhịp, bước

Congestion frequently reduces traffic to walking pace.

incessant

(adjective). không dừng lại

She raised her voice above the incessant beat of the music.

miniaturisation

(noun). tiểu (hình) hóa

The trend towards miniaturization of digital devices has been going on for several years.

hazard

(noun). mối nguy hiểm

Growing levels of pollution represent a serious health hazard to the local population.

scramble

(verb). leo thang

She managed to scramble over the wall.

menacing

(adjective). hăm doạ, đe doạ

At night, the dark streets become menacing.

tumultuous

(adjective). Một cách bừa bãi, một cách hỗn độn; dữ dội

The former president appeared to tumultuous applause and a standing ovation.

myriad

(adjective). rất nhiều

And now myriads of bars and hotels are opening up along the coast.

mainframe

(noun). Hệ thống máy vi tính lớn

This has been because the mini and mainframe programming environments and the languages used did not support it.

workstation

(noun). trạm làm việc (trong mạng máy tính)

Vending machines and water coolers mean staff spend little time away from their workstations.

simultaneously

(adverb). đồng thời

The game will be broadcast simultaneously on TV and radio.

collective

(adjective). Tập thể; chung

It was formed as a permanent association of employers to represent their collective interests.

sections.title: Passage 3: SAVING LANGUAGE
sections.html:
extinct

(adjective). tuyệt chủng

There is concern that the giant panda will soon become extinct.

extraordinary

(adjective). phi thường

He told the extraordinary story of his escape.

extinction

(noun). sự tuyệt chủng

The extinction of the dinosaurs occurred millions of years ago.

massive

(adjective). to lớn

They have a massive house.

scale

(noun). tỉ lệ

How would you rate his work on a scale of 1 to 5?

language

(noun). ngôn ngữ

She does research into how children acquire language.

linguist

(noun). nhà ngôn ngữ học

Public opinion research is not an area that has received much attention from applied linguists.

decade

(noun). thập kỉ

Air traffic has increased 30% in the last decade.

gather

(verb). thu thập

I went to several libraries to gather information about the plans.

comparative

(adjective). có thể so sánh được

"Fatter" is the comparative of "fat".

survive

(verb). sống sót

The baby was born with a heart problem and only survived for a few hours.

conclusion

(noun). kết luận

Be careful not to introduce new ideas in the conclusion of your essay.

speaker

(noun). người phát biểu

Please join with me in thanking our guest speaker tonight.

certain

(adjective). chắc chắn

I feel certain (that) you're doing the right thing.

vulnerable

(adjective). dễ bị tổn thương

I felt very vulnerable, standing there without any clothes on.

major

(adjective). quan trọng, tầm cỡ

You must be careful with these major parts of a car.

community

(noun). cộng đồng

He's well known in the local community.

threat

(noun). đe doạ

The threat of jail failed to deter him from petty crime.

indigenous

(adjective). bản địa

Are there any species of frog indigenous to the area?

procedure

(noun). thủ tục, thể thức

The company has new procedures for dealing with complaints.

culture

(noun). văn hoá

She's studying modern Japanese language and culture.

respect

(verb). tôn trọng

I have great/the greatest respect for his ideas, although I don't agree with them.

minority

(noun). phần thiểu số

It's only a tiny minority of people who are causing the problem.

linguist

(noun). nhà ngôn ngữ học

This will be an invaluable text for teachers of foreign languages, those responsible for training teachers and applied linguists.

field

(noun). cánh đồng

We drove past fields of ripening wheat.

analyst

(noun). phân tích viên

Most financial analysts have been surprised by the persistence of the recession.

resource

(noun). nguồn tài nguyên

The country's greatest resource is the dedication of its workers.

compile

(verb). tập hợp

We're compiling some facts and figures for a documentary on the subject.

material

(noun). nguyên vật liệu, tài liệu

Crude oil is used as the raw (= basic) material for making plastics.

region

(noun). vùng miền

The war is threatening to engulf the entire region.

independence

(noun). sự độc lập

Mexico gained its independence from Spain in 1821.

associated

(adjective). liên kết

She was prepared to take on the job, with all its associated risks.

degree

(noun). mức độ

This job demands a high degree of skill.

political

(adjective). mang tính chính trị

There are two major political parties in the US - the Democratic Party and the Republican Party.

autonomy

(noun). tự chủ tự cường

Demonstrators demanded immediate autonomy for their region.

strike

(verb). đánh

Democratization has brought workers the right to strike and join a trade union.

prejudice

(noun). thành kiến

Laws against racial prejudice must be strictly enforced.

attitude

(noun). thái độ

It's often very difficult to change people's attitudes.

positive

(adjective). tích cực

On a more positive note, we're seeing signs that the housing market is picking up.

immersion

(noun). sự nhúng, trồi dậy

We have all learned a complex set of grammar rules simply by immersion in a language since birth.

sector

(noun). khu vực

In the financial sector, banks and insurance companies have both lost a lot of money.

organization

(noun). tổ chức

The article was about the international aid organizations.

domestic

(adjective). thuộc về gia đình

Domestic opinion had turned against the war.

intensively

(adverb). đầy kỹ lưỡng

She is studying intensively, working toward her degree.

expose

(verb). phơi bày ra

The plaster on the walls has been removed to expose the original bricks underneath.

variety

(noun). sự đa dạng

When planning meals, you need to think about variety and taste as well as nutritional value.

solution

(noun). giải pháp

There's no easy solution to this problem.

creation

(noun). sự sáng tạo

This 25-foot-high sculpture is her latest creation.

unify

(verb). thống nhất

If the new leader does manage to unify his warring party it will be quite an achievement.

dialect

(noun). phương ngữ

The poem is written in northern dialect.

permit

(verb). cho phép

The regulations do not permit much flexibility.

revitalisation

(noun). sự hồi sinh

A new indoor sports arena has played a key role in the revitalization of its neighborhood.

document

(verb). ghi nhận

His interest in cars has been well-documented by the media.

endanger

(verb). gây nguy hiểm

He would never do anything to endanger the lives of his children.

revitalise

(verb). hồi sinh

Japanese investment has revitalized this part of Britain.

generalise

(verb). Tổng quát hoá; khái quát hoá

You can't generalize about a continent as varied as Europe.

presence

(noun). sự hiện hữu

She was overawed by the presence of so many people.

brink

(noun). bờ vực

She was standing right on the brink of the gorge.

resurrect

(verb). làm sống lại

Almost all Christians believe that Jesus was resurrected from the dead.

description

(noun). sự miêu tả

Write a description of your favourite beach.

precondition

(noun). tiền đề

A halt to the fighting is a precondition for negotiations.

minimally

(adverb). rất nhỏ

Airport sales are increasing minimally, if at all.

alternative

(adjective). khác

The opposition parties have so far failed to set out an alternative strategy.

civilisation

(noun). nền văn minh

Some people think that nuclear war would mean the end of civilization.

illiterate

(adjective). mù chữ

A surprising percentage of the population is illiterate.
